about: Workshop recipe cards for the recipe box. Every visitor sees these. Newest entries go at the end; the page shows the newest first.

recipes.title: The brilliant new employee brief
ingredients: What a good result looks like
recipes.method: I'm planning [what it is] for [who it's for]. It matters because [why]. Please make [the thing], about [length], in [format]. A great result would [what success looks like]. Include [anything extra you want], and ask me questions first if something is unclear.
recipes.notes: Anthropic suggests treating Claude like a brilliant new employee who doesn't know your house rules yet. If a friend with no background would be confused by your prompt, Claude will be too.

recipes.title: Show it a few examples
ingredients: Three samples of the style you like
The new thing you want written
recipes.method:
Here are examples of the style I like:
<example>[first sample]</example>
<example>[second sample]</example>
<example>[third sample]</example>
Now write [the new thing] in the same style.
recipes.notes: Examples are one of the most reliable ways to steer tone and format. Anthropic recommends 3 to 5, and making them different from each other so Claude copies the style, not one quirk.
